scope: Global integer power P; each level uses n_i*k_i dividing P and repeats its paired block P/(n_i*k_i) times; arbitrary arities, optional input/output swaps, legal crops, types and initial dimensions. Ordinary source evaluation, uncompressed auxiliaries, prescribed copies, separate block exactification, terminal first-input projection and actual pooling ceiling are retained, over Q/characteristic zero.
proved_finite_statement: A<=2^128 and B>A imply actual paid exponent p>=29/10, including variable local n_i and k_i in this integer-replication model.
favorable_relaxation: For each retained arity choose any 3<=n<=P with positive maximum sector gain and k=floor(P/n), even when n*k does not divide P. Take a rational interval minimum of the normalized local quality costs. No fractional tensor construction is asserted.
limitations: The 2.95 relaxed gate has unexcluded multisets; these are not certified constructions.
Different source circuits, compressed auxiliaries, joint exactification, and arbitrary inventory mechanisms outside the explicit global-P replication model are not covered.
The core variable finite gate, all frozen rounds7-10, and the paper remain unchanged.
